name: swift-ios-feature-commit-workflow
description: End-to-end workflow for implementing a new feature in a Swift iOS Clean Architecture project: domain model → repository protocol → repository impl → use case → ViewModel → View → tests → commit.
when_to_use: When implementing any new feature screen or data flow in a Swift iOS project following Clean Architecture layers (Domain / Data / Presentation).
workflow_sequences: 1. Define Domain model (value-type struct, Sendable) in Domain/Models/
2. Add async throws protocol to Domain/Repositories/
3. Implement XxxRepositoryImpl in Data/Repositories/ with GRDB local + APIClient remote calls
4. Add Endpoint struct + DTO in Data/Remote/; add Domain mapper extension
5. Write UseCase struct with callAsFunction; register in AppContainer
7. Write SwiftUI View; use .task modifier for async loads
8. Add Route case and RouteDestinationView switch arm
9. Add Russian localization strings to ru.lproj/Localizable.strings
10. Write unit tests: mock repository → UseCase test, ViewModel test
11. Run xcodebuild tests (EPD-Dev scheme) — must pass before commit
12. Update memory bank activeContext.md with completed work entry
example_invocations: Implement CounterpartyDetails feature: fetch remote details and display in CounterpartyProfileView
Add DocumentScanner screen with VisionKit stub and upload integration
Wire PushNotifications: AppDelegate + FCM token POST to backend
troubleshooting_tips: Swift 6.2 strict concurrency: all repo protocols and use case structs must be Sendable; ViewModels use @ObservationIgnored nonisolated(unsafe) only for Task vars accessed in deinit
Token refresh 401 loops: APIClient actor handles concurrency; never call refresh manually from ViewModel
GRDB actor isolation: all DB writes must be on DatabaseQueue writer; reads can use reader
Localization: zero Cyrillic literals in Swift files — all strings via .localized extension
Route navigation: add case to Route enum and arm to RouteDestinationView; inject NavigationRouter into ViewModel
MainView child VMs: initialize outside body, reinitialize on activeCounterparty change to avoid stale state
